en.title: Compress Transparent PNG Images in Batches - Coding.Tools
en.description: Losslessly compress transparent PNGs, icons and screenshots in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Losslessly compress transparent PNGs, icons and screenshots in your browser.
en.dropzoneMessage: Click or drag PNG files here to upload
en.descTitle: Compress PNGs without sending files to a server
descParas: Oxipng optimizes how PNG pixels are stored while preserving their colors, transparency and dimensions.
If the optimized file is the same size or larger, you get the original. Animated PNGs are returned intact so all frames are preserved.
steps: Drag and drop PNG files onto the upload area, or click to select files.
Compare the original and output sizes to see how many bytes you saved.
Download each result separately, or download multiple results together as a ZIP.
whatIsParas: Logos, icons and screenshots with flat colors often compress well. Already optimized files may yield little or no saving.
en.examplePara: This Python example uses Pillow to optimize a static PNG and keeps the smaller file.
en.exampleCode:
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

source = Path('input.png').read_bytes()
with Image.open(BytesIO(source)) as image:
    result = source
    if not image.is_animated:
        buffer = BytesIO()
        image.save(buffer, format='PNG', optimize=True)
        result = min((source, buffer.getvalue()), key=len)

Path('compressed.png').write_bytes(result)
